stack.fileUploads: Multer (memory storage) + Sharp compression before GCS upload
security: Mongoose NoSQL injection CVE patched (dependency audit)

middleware.js/placeRouter.js query construction reviewed 2026-09-14 — queries are built from JWT-derived _id and route params, not raw req.query/req.body operator objects; low risk. Place.create(req.body) in placeRouter.js relies on Mongoose strict-mode field-stripping rather than an explicit whitelist — optional hardening, not an active vulnerability
GET /users/:userId restricted to admins (fixed 2026-09-14 — previously any authenticated user could fetch any other user's full profile by id)

server.utils/imageProcessing.js: Sharp compression pipeline run before GCS upload
server.scripts: Standalone maintenance scripts (e.g. drop-title-index.js) — avoid importing Mongoose models directly, use mongoose.connection.collection() instead

steps: User.register(user, password) — passport-local-mongoose's built-in helper, called directly, no workaround needed

localLogin: Cloud Functions pre-parses the request body, breaking passport-local-mongoose's stream-based authenticate() — passport.authenticate('local') is bypassed
Password verified via user.authenticate(password, callback) called directly

authorizationFlow.verifyUser: Ensures JWT is valid and user is authenticated
authorizationFlow.verifyPlaceOwner: Ensures user owns the requested place

routes.GET /users/auth/google/callback: Google OAuth callback, redirects to frontend with JWT
routes.PATCH /users/me: Update current user — supports username, firstname, lastname, email, and password (currentPassword + newPassword) changes via allowedFields
routes.GET /users/:userId: Look up a user by id — admin only (fixed 2026-09-14; previously had no admin/ownership check)
routes.DELETE /users/:userId: Delete a user and cascade-delete their places/images — admin only

routes.GET /places: Return places owned by authenticated user
routes.POST /places: Create new place with optional image upload
routes.GET /places/:placeId: Return single place if owned by user

placeApi.needsReview: GET /places and GET /places/:placeId populate the full owner document (middleware.js loadPlaces, placeRouter.js :placeId GET), while POST /places limits it to .populate('owner', 'username'). Not a cross-user leak (owner is always the requesting user), but responses carry the owner's email/admin/timestamps instead of the documented {id, username} shape. Recommend aligning all three to the minimal populate.

fileUploadFlow.processing: sharp (server/utils/imageProcessing.js) — EXIF auto-rotate + strip, resize to 1600px max width (withoutEnlargement), format-specific quality — runs before upload

changes: nested owner._id and note ids normalized

securityFeatures: Mongoose NoSQL injection CVE patched (dependency audit)
middleware.js/placeRouter.js query construction reviewed 2026-09-14 — low risk, see stack.security
